memory.title: Memory Settings
memory.short_term_desc: Retains the current session's context (recent turns) to keep the conversation coherent. Scoped to this session and cleared when it ends.
memory.long_term_desc: Persists important facts and conclusions across sessions into long-term storage (vector index) for retrieval in later sessions.
memory.consent_note: Memory writes require the Agent's write permission; when enabled the model may read the corresponding memory while reasoning.
memory.retention_note: Short-term memory lives for the session; long-term memory is archived automatically by budget and retention policy — it never grows unbounded.
memory.message_pairs_desc: Number of recent conversation turns kept in short-term memory (2-20).
memory.summary_threshold_desc: A summary is generated automatically once turns exceed this threshold (8-40).
memory.summary_token_budget_desc: Maximum tokens usable when generating a summary (256-2048).
memory.long_term_inert_note: These parameters are saved now, but only take effect once long-term memory ships in a future release.
memory.recall_token_budget_desc: Maximum tokens usable when recalling long-term memory (128-1200).
memory.recall_count_desc: Maximum number of entries returned per long-term memory recall (1-12).
memory.consent_checkbox: I agree to store this memory as a confirmed fact
memory.error_conflict: This memory has an open conflict that must be resolved first
memory.error_consent_required: This action requires your explicit consent

recon.title: Agent Reconciliation
recon.help_cas: Every submission runs a version CAS; if the case was concurrently modified (revision conflict) the submission fails with a notice.
recon.help_failed: Confirmed not-run: the external side effect did not happen (requires a provider terminal-failure reference).
recon.help_how: Open a case to inspect its evidence and timeline → record provider evidence → choose a disposition:
recon.help_retry: Not accepted, retry: with conclusive non-acceptance evidence and an unchanged idempotent descriptor, the Turn is re-queued with a new dispatch generation.
recon.help_succeeded: Confirmed succeeded: the external side effect did happen (requires provider execution reference/result evidence).
recon.help_what: When a tool/action execution has an unknown final outcome, the system never auto-replays; it opens a reconciliation case for an admin to confirm the outcome from external side-effect evidence.
recon.help_when: A non-idempotent execution returns an unknown outcome: tool call result lost, execution fence lost, or an unknown result.
